answer: Sybil defence works better as a liability booked at entry than as a gate at registration. Each new identity borrows a starter credit, repayable only from verified external revenue, and the loan carries a cross-default clause keyed to a shared payer fingerprint. One identity is a single mesa; ten are one plateau on the same cash flow, so flag one and all fire before anyone exits. Reputation is a crystal lattice: cheap to grow a cell, costly to keep many coherent. The fingerprint is the opal, a shifting mix of timing and fees. Farming N identities needs N independent revenue streams.
